place.name: Egmond Castle
place.description: Egmond Castle (Dutch: Kasteel Egmond), locally known as Slot op den Hoef and also called the Ruins of Egmond (Dutch: Ruïne van Egmond), is a ruined medieval castle in Egmond aan den Hoef, in the municipality of Bergen in the Dutch province of North Holland. It lies about 7 kilometres (4.3 mi) west of Alkmaar.
